db:select.doc:name: Count Open Tickets for Pagination
db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_id) AS total_count FROM public.tickets t JOIN public.customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id JOIN public.sla_policies p ON p.priority = t.priority AND p.customer_tier = c.customer_tier WHERE t.ticket_status IN ( 'OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'AWAITING_INTERNAL' ) AND t.resolved_at IS NULL;

set-variable.value: #[if (vars.totalTickets <= 0) [] else (0 to (ceil(vars.totalTickets / vars.fetchSize) - 1)) map ((pageNumber) -> pageNumber * vars.fetchSize)]
set-variable.doc:name: Build Ticket Page Offsets

db:insert.doc:name: Create SLA Run Audit Record
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO public.sla_evaluation_runs ( run_id, started_at, completed_at, evaluated_count, on_track_count, at_risk_count, breached_count, severe_count, escalated_count, events_published, digests_sent, suppressed_count, run_status, correlation_id ) VALUES ( :runId, NOW(), NULL, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 'RUNNING', :runId );

db:select.db:sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.subject, t.priority, t.ticket_status, t.created_at, t.first_response_at, t.resolved_at, t.customer_id, c.customer_tier, t.assigned_agent_id, a.manager_id, m.manager_email, m.manager_status, p.first_response_target_mins, p.resolution_target_mins, p.business_calendar_code, COALESCE(s.last_alert_level_response, 0) AS last_alert_level_response, COALESCE(s.last_alert_level_resolution, 0) AS last_alert_level_resolution, COALESCE(ph.pause_intervals_json, '[]') AS pause_intervals_json FROM public.tickets t JOIN public.customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id JOIN public.sla_policies p ON p.priority = t.priority AND p.customer_tier = c.customer_tier LEFT JOIN public.agents a ON a.agent_id = t.assigned_agent_id LEFT JOIN public.managers m ON m.manager_id = a.manager_id LEFT JOIN public.ticket_sla_state s ON s.ticket_id = t.ticket_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ticket_id, json_agg( json_build_object( 'paused_from', paused_from, 'paused_to', paused_to ) ORDER BY paused_from )::text AS pause_intervals_json FROM public.ticket_pause_history WHERE pause_status IN ( 'AWAITING_CUSTOMER', 'PENDING_THIRD_PARTY', 'ON_HOLD_APPROVED' ) GROUP BY ticket_id ) ph ON ph.ticket_id = t.ticket_id WHERE t.ticket_status IN ( 'OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'AWAITING_INTERNAL' ) AND t.resolved_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.priority, t.created_at LIMIT :fetchSize OFFSET :offset;

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- vars.auditCounts ++ { evaluatedCount: vars.auditCounts.evaluatedCount + 1, onTrackCount: vars.auditCounts.onTrackCount + (if (payload.response_band == "ON_TRACK" and payload.resolution_band == "ON_TRACK") 1 else 0), atRiskCount: vars.auditCounts.atRiskCount + (if (payload.response_band == "AT_RISK" or payload.resolution_band == "AT_RISK") 1 else 0), breachedCount: vars.auditCounts.breachedCount + (if (payload.response_band == "BREACHED" or payload.resolution_band == "BREACHED") 1 else 0), severeCount: vars.auditCounts.severeCount + (if (payload.response_band == "SEVERELY_BREACHED" or payload.resolution_band == "SEVERELY_BREACHED") 1 else 0) }]
set-variable.doc:name: Accumulate SLA Audit Counts

db:insert.doc:name: New SLA Alert Record
db:insert.db:sql:
INSERT INTO public.sla_alert_log ( run_id, ticket_id, clock_type, from_level, to_level, band, event_published, email_status, suppressed_reason, alerted_at ) SELECT :runId, :ticketId, 'RESPONSE', :lastResponseLevel, :currentResponseLevel, :responseBand, FALSE, 'PENDING', NULL, NOW() WHERE :currentResponseLevel > :lastResponseLevel
UNION ALL
SELECT :runId, :ticketId, 'RESOLUTION', :lastResolutionLevel, :currentResolutionLevel, :resolutionBand, FALSE, 'PENDING', NULL, NOW() WHERE :currentResolutionLevel > :lastResolutionLevel
ON CONFLICT (ticket_id, clock_type, to_level) DO NOTHING;
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ runId: vars.runId, ticketId: vars.currentTicket.ticket_id, lastResponseLevel: vars.currentTicket.last_alert_level_response, currentResponseLevel: vars.currentTicket.current_alert_level_response, responseBand: vars.currentTicket.response_band, lastResolutionLevel: vars.currentTicket.last_alert_level_resolution, currentResolutionLevel: vars.currentTicket.current_alert_level_resolution, resolutionBand: vars.currentTicket.resolution_band }]

db:insert.doc:name: Ticket SLA State
db:insert.db:sql:
INSERT INTO public.ticket_sla_state ( ticket_id, response_elapsed_mins, resolution_elapsed_mins, response_band, resolution_band, last_alert_level_response, last_alert_level_resolution, last_alerted_at, last_evaluated_run_id ) VALUES ( :ticketId, :responseElapsed, :resolutionElapsed, :responseBand, :resolutionBand, :currentResponseLevel, :currentResolutionLevel, CASE WHEN :currentResponseLevel > :lastResponseLevel OR :currentResolutionLevel > :lastResolutionLevel THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, :runId ) ON CONFLICT (ticket_id) DO UPDATE SET response_elapsed_mins = EXCLUDED.response_elapsed_mins, resolution_elapsed_mins = EXCLUDED.resolution_elapsed_mins, response_band = EXCLUDED.response_band, resolution_band = EXCLUDED.resolution_band,
last_alert_level_response = GREATEST( COALESCE( ticket_sla_state.last_alert_level_response, 0 ), COALESCE( EXCLUDED.last_alert_level_response, 0 ) ),
last_alert_level_resolution = GREATEST( COALESCE( ticket_sla_state.last_alert_level_resolution, 0 ), COALESCE( EXCLUDED.last_alert_level_resolution, 0 ) ),
last_alerted_at = CASE WHEN COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_alert_level_response, 0) > COALESCE( ticket_sla_state.last_alert_level_response, 0 ) OR COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_alert_level_resolution, 0) > COALESCE( ticket_sla_state.last_alert_level_resolution, 0 ) THEN NOW() ELSE ticket_sla_state.last_alerted_at END,
last_evaluated_run_id = EXCLUDED.last_evaluated_run_id;
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ ticketId: vars.currentTicket.ticket_id, responseElapsed: vars.currentTicket.response_elapsed_mins, resolutionElapsed: vars.currentTicket.resolution_elapsed_mins, responseBand: vars.currentTicket.response_band, resolutionBand: vars.currentTicket.resolution_band, currentResponseLevel: vars.currentTicket.current_alert_level_response, currentResolutionLevel: vars.currentTicket.current_alert_level_resolution, lastResponseLevel: vars.currentTicket.last_alert_level_response, lastResolutionLevel: vars.currentTicket.last_alert_level_resolution, runId: vars.runId }]

db:update.doc:name: Complete SLA Run Audit
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE public.sla_evaluation_runs SET evaluated_count = :evaluatedCount, on_track_count = :onTrackCount, at_risk_count = :atRiskCount, breached_count = :breachedCount, severe_count = :severeCount, escalated_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.sla_alert_log WHERE run_id = :runId ), completed_at = NOW(), run_status = 'COMPLETED', correlation_id = COALESCE(correlation_id, :runId) WHERE run_id = :runId AND run_status = 'RUNNING';
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ runId: vars.runId as String, evaluatedCount: vars.auditCounts.evaluatedCount, onTrackCount: vars.auditCounts.onTrackCount, atRiskCount: vars.auditCounts.atRiskCount, breachedCount: vars.auditCounts.breachedCount, severeCount: vars.auditCounts.severeCount }]

db:update.doc:name: Cancel Resolved Pending Alerts
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE public.sla_alert_log al SET email_status = 'CANCELLED_RESOLVED', suppressed_reason = 'Ticket resolved before notification' FROM public.tickets t WHERE al.ticket_id = t.ticket_id AND al.event_published = FALSE AND COALESCE(al.email_status, 'PENDING') IN ( 'PENDING', 'RECOVERY_PENDING', 'RECOVERY_QUEUED' ) AND ( t.resolved_at IS NOT NULL OR t.ticket_status NOT IN ( 'OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'AWAITING_INTERNAL' ) );

db:select.doc:name: Select Pending SLA Alerts
db:select.db:sql: SELECT alert_seq, run_id, ticket_id, clock_type, to_level, band FROM public.sla_alert_log WHERE event_published = FALSE AND ticket_id NOT IN ( SELECT ticket_id FROM public.tickets WHERE ticket_status IN ( 'RESOLVED', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED_RESOLVED' ) OR resolved_at IS NOT NULL );

logger.doc:name: DEBUG - Dispatcher About to Publish
logger.message: #['DISPATCHER_ABOUT_TO_PUBLISH: alert_seq=' ++ (vars.currentAlert.alert_seq as String) ++ ', run_id=' ++ (vars.currentAlert.run_id as String)]

db:update.doc:name: Mark SLA Alert Published
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE public.sla_alert_log SET event_published = TRUE WHERE alert_seq = :alertSeq AND event_published = FALSE;

db:update.doc:name: Increment Published Event Audit

when.expression: #[((now() >> 'Asia/Kolkata') as String {format: 'HH:mm'}) >= p('notification.quietHoursEnd') and ((now() >> 'Asia/Kolkata') as String {format: 'HH:mm'}) < p('notification.quietHoursStart')]

db:select.db:sql: SELECT run_id, MIN(alert_seq) AS alert_seq FROM public.sla_alert_log WHERE ( email_status = 'SUPPRESSED' AND suppressed_reason = 'Quiet hours' ) OR email_status = 'RECOVERY_PENDING' GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY MIN(alert_seq);

db:update.doc:name: Prepare Suppressed Digest Recovery
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE public.sla_alert_log SET email_status = 'RECOVERY_PENDING', processing_token = NULL WHERE run_id = :runId AND ( (email_status = 'SUPPRESSED' AND suppressed_reason = 'Quiet hours') OR email_status = 'RECOVERY_PENDING' );

set-payload.doc:name: Set Payload

db:update.doc:name: Mark Recovery Queued
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE public.sla_alert_log SET email_status = 'RECOVERY_QUEUED' WHERE run_id = :runId AND email_status = 'RECOVERY_PENDING';

db:update.doc:name: Cancel Alerts for Resolved Tickets
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE public.sla_alert_log al SET email_status = 'CANCELLED_RESOLVED', suppressed_reason = 'Ticket resolved before notification' FROM public.tickets t WHERE al.ticket_id = t.ticket_id AND al.run_id = :runId AND al.email_status IN ( 'PENDING', 'RECOVERY_PENDING', 'RECOVERY_QUEUED', 'PROCESSING', 'SUPPRESSED' ) AND ( t.resolved_at IS NOT NULL OR t.ticket_status IN ( 'RESOLVED', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED_RESOLVED' ) );

db:update.doc:name: Claim Pending Digest Alerts
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE public.sla_alert_log SET email_status = 'PROCESSING', processing_token = :claimToken WHERE alert_seq = :alertSeq AND run_id = :runId AND email_status IN ( 'PENDING', 'RECOVERY_PENDING', 'RECOVERY_QUEUED' );

db:select.db:sql: SELECT al.alert_seq, al.run_id, al.ticket_id, al.clock_type, al.from_level, al.to_level, al.band, al.alerted_at, t.subject, t.priority, c.customer_tier, t.assigned_agent_id, a.manager_id, m.manager_name, m.manager_email, m.manager_status, p.business_calendar_code, CASE WHEN al.clock_type = 'RESPONSE' THEN p.first_response_target_mins ELSE p.resolution_target_mins END AS target_minutes, CASE WHEN al.clock_type = 'RESPONSE' THEN s.response_elapsed_mins ELSE s.resolution_elapsed_mins END AS elapsed_business_minutes FROM public.sla_alert_log al JOIN public.tickets t ON t.ticket_id = al.ticket_id JOIN public.customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id LEFT JOIN public.agents a ON a.agent_id = t.assigned_agent_id LEFT JOIN public.managers m ON m.manager_id = a.manager_id JOIN public.sla_policies p ON p.priority = t.priority AND p.customer_tier = c.customer_tier JOIN public.ticket_sla_state s ON s.ticket_id = al.ticket_id WHERE al.run_id = :runId AND al.email_status = 'PROCESSING' AND al.processing_token = :claimToken ORDER BY al.alerted_at, al.alert_seq;

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/java
var alerts = payload default [] var fallbackEmail = vars.slaPolicy.notification.fallbackDistributionList
var normalizedAlerts = alerts map (a) -> do { var needsFallback = a.manager_id == null or isEmpty((a.manager_email default "") as String) or upper((a.manager_status default "") as String) != "ACTIVE" --- { alert: a, recipientKey: if (needsFallback) "FALLBACK" else a.manager_id as String, usesFallback: needsFallback } }
--- (normalizedAlerts groupBy ((item) -> item.recipientKey)) pluck ((items, recipientKey) -> do { var managerAlerts = items map ((item) -> item.alert) var maxTickets = (vars.slaPolicy.notification.maxTicketsPerDigest default 50) as Number
var orderedAlerts = managerAlerts orderBy ((a) -> if (a.band == "SEVERELY_BREACHED") 0 else if (a.band == "BREACHED") 1 else if (a.band == "AT_RISK") 2 else 3 )
var digestAlerts = orderedAlerts filter ((alert, index) -> index < maxTickets) var useFallback = items[0].usesFallback --- { managerId: if (useFallback) "FALLBACK" else managerAlerts[0].manager_id,
managerName: if (useFallback) "Support Leadership" else managerAlerts[0].manager_name,
managerEmail: if (useFallback) fallbackEmail else managerAlerts[0].manager_email,
runId: managerAlerts[0].run_id,
runTime: now() as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" },
escalatedCount: sizeOf( (managerAlerts map ((a) -> a.ticket_id)) distinctBy ((id) -> id) ),
businessCalendars: ((managerAlerts map ((a) -> a.business_calendar_code)) distinctBy ((code) -> code)) joinBy ", ",
alertSeqs: managerAlerts map ((a) -> a.alert_seq),
severeTickets: digestAlerts filter ((a) -> a.band == "SEVERELY_BREACHED"),
breachedTickets: digestAlerts filter ((a) -> a.band == "BREACHED"),
atRiskTickets: digestAlerts filter ((a) -> a.band == "AT_RISK"),
immediateSevereTickets: managerAlerts filter ((a) -> a.band == "SEVERELY_BREACHED"),
totalAlertCount: sizeOf(managerAlerts), displayedAlertCount: sizeOf(digestAlerts) } })

%dw 2.0 output text/plain
var t = vars.severeTicket --- "IMMEDIATE SEVERE SLA BREACH NOTIFICATION

" ++ "Dear " ++ ((t.manager_name default "Support Manager") as String) ++ ",

" ++ "The following ticket has reached the SEVERELY_BREACHED level and requires immediate attention.

" ++ "Ticket: " ++ ((t.ticket_id default "Unknown") as String) ++ "
" ++ "Subject: " ++ ((t.subject default "No subject") as String) ++ "
" ++ "Priority: " ++ ((t.priority default "Unknown") as String) ++ "
" ++ "Customer tier: " ++ ((t.customer_tier default "Unknown") as String) ++ "
" ++ "Clock type: " ++ ((t.clock_type default "Unknown") as String) ++ "
" ++ "Target: " ++ ((t.target_minutes default 0) as String) ++ " minutes
" ++ "Elapsed business time: " ++ ((t.elapsed_business_minutes default 0) as String) ++ " minutes
" ++ "Overdue by: " ++ ((max([ 0, ((t.elapsed_business_minutes default 0) as Number) - ((t.target_minutes default 0) as Number) ])) as String) ++ " minutes
" ++ "Assigned agent: " ++ ((t.assigned_agent_id default "Unassigned") as String) ++ "
" ++ "Run ID: " ++ ((vars.managerDigest.runId default "Unknown") as String) ++ "

" ++ "Regards,
Support Operations Monitoring"

email:send.doc:name: Send Immediate Severe Email
email:send.subject: #["IMMEDIATE SEVERE SLA BREACH – " ++ vars.severeTicket.ticket_id ++ " – " ++ vars.severeTicket.clock_type]
email:send.toAddresses: #[[if (!isEmpty((vars.managerDigest.managerEmail default "") as String)) (vars.managerDigest.managerEmail as String) else p("notification.fallbackDistributionList")]]

logger.doc:name: Log Immediate Severe Email Failure
logger.message: #["Immediate severe email failed after retries for ticket " ++ ((vars.severeTicket.ticket_id default "UNKNOWN") as String) ++ ": " ++ error.description]

when.expression: #[(((now() >> 'Asia/Kolkata') as String {format: 'HH:mm'}) >= p('notification.quietHoursStart')) or (((now() >> 'Asia/Kolkata') as String {format: 'HH:mm'}) < p('notification.quietHoursEnd'))]

db:update.doc:name: Increment Suppressed Digest Audit

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output text/plain
var d: Any = vars.managerDigest default {} var severe = (d["severeTickets"] default []) as Array<Any> var breached = (d["breachedTickets"] default []) as Array<Any> var atRisk = (d["atRiskTickets"] default []) as Array<Any>
--- "Dear " ++ ((d["managerName"] default "Support Manager") as String) ++ ",

" ++ "The following tickets in your team have newly crossed an SLA threshold in the evaluation completed at " ++ ((d["runTime"] default "Time unavailable") as String) ++ ".

" ++ "Run ID: " ++ ((d["runId"] default "Unknown") as String) ++ "
" ++ "Tickets newly escalated: " ++ ((d["escalatedCount"] default 0) as String) ++ "

" ++
(if (sizeOf(severe) > 0) "SEVERELY BREACHED – immediate attention required
" ++ ((severe map ((t) -> "• " ++ ((t["ticket_id"] default "Unknown") as String) ++ " – " ++ ((t["priority"] default "Unknown") as String) ++ " – " ++ ((t["customer_tier"] default "Unknown") as String) ++ " – " ++ ((t["clock_type"] default "Unknown") as String) ++ "
 " ++ ((t["subject"] default "No subject") as String) ++ "
 Target " ++ ((t["target_minutes"] default 0) as String) ++ " min, elapsed " ++ ((t["elapsed_business_minutes"] default 0) as String) ++ " min (overdue by " ++ ((max([ 0, ((t["elapsed_business_minutes"] default 0) as Number) - ((t["target_minutes"] default 0) as Number) ])) as String) ++ " min), agent " ++ ((t["assigned_agent_id"] default "Unassigned") as String) )) joinBy "
") ++ "

" else "") ++
(if (sizeOf(breached) > 0) "BREACHED
" ++ ((breached map ((t) -> "• " ++ ((t["ticket_id"] default "Unknown") as String) ++ " – " ++ ((t["priority"] default "Unknown") as String) ++ " – " ++ ((t["customer_tier"] default "Unknown") as String) ++ " – " ++ ((t["clock_type"] default "Unknown") as String) ++ "
 " ++ ((t["subject"] default "No subject") as String) ++ "
 Target " ++ ((t["target_minutes"] default 0) as String) ++ " min, elapsed " ++ ((t["elapsed_business_minutes"] default 0) as String) ++ " min (overdue by " ++ ((max([ 0, ((t["elapsed_business_minutes"] default 0) as Number) - ((t["target_minutes"] default 0) as Number) ])) as String) ++ " min), agent " ++ ((t["assigned_agent_id"] default "Unassigned") as String) )) joinBy "
") ++ "

" else "") ++
(if (sizeOf(atRisk) > 0) "AT RISK – approaching target
" ++ ((atRisk map ((t) -> "• " ++ ((t["ticket_id"] default "Unknown") as String) ++ " – " ++ ((t["priority"] default "Unknown") as String) ++ " – " ++ ((t["clock_type"] default "Unknown") as String) ++ " – " ++ (if (((t["target_minutes"] default 0) as Number) > 0) ((round( (((t["elapsed_business_minutes"] default 0) as Number) / ((t["target_minutes"] default 1) as Number)) * 100 )) as String) else "0") ++ "% of target consumed, " ++ ((max([ 0, ((t["target_minutes"] default 0) as Number) - ((t["elapsed_business_minutes"] default 0) as Number) ])) as String) ++ " min remaining" )) joinBy "
") ++ "

" else "") ++
"Elapsed time is measured in business hours using calendar " ++ ((d["businessCalendars"] default "configured business calendar") as String) ++ " and excludes time awaiting customer response.

" ++ "Each ticket appears in this digest only when it crosses to a higher escalation level, so a ticket already reported at this level is not repeated.

" ++ "Regards,
Support Operations Monitoring"

email:send.toAddresses: #[[if (!isEmpty((vars.managerDigest.managerEmail default "") as String)) (vars.managerDigest.managerEmail as String) else p("notification.fallbackDistributionList")]]
email:send.subject: #["SLA Breach Digest – " ++ vars.managerDigest.runTime]
